affordances.name: Rotate Exhibit Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider control that rotates the pedestal group around Y-axis from 0 to 360 degrees

affordances.name: Spotlight Intensity Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider control that adjusts spotlight intensity from 0.0 to 5.0

affordances.name: DamagedHelmet Artifact
affordances.semantic: Central exhibition piece - ancient helmet model displayed on center pedestal

affordances.name: ShaderBall Pedestals
affordances.semantic: Three ShaderBall models serving as display pedestals in triangular formation

affordances.name: Gallery Floor
affordances.semantic: Reflective polished concrete floor plane with grid texture

affordances.name: OrbitControls
affordances.semantic: Camera controls allowing orbital navigation around the exhibition

states.name: Initial Load
states.description: Scene is initializing, assets are being loaded, lighting and floor are being set up

states.name: Assets Loaded
states.description: All 3D models loaded, pedestals positioned, helmet elevated, floor reflective, controls active
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.assetsLoaded === true && window.__3D_STATE__.pedestalCount === 3 && window.__3D_STATE__.controlsEnabled === true

states.name: Exhibit Rotated
states.description: User has rotated the pedestal group using the rotation slider to a non-zero angle

states.name: Spotlight Adjusted
states.description: User has modified the spotlight intensity to illuminate the helmet differently

states.name: Maximum Spotlight
states.description: Spotlight intensity set to maximum value (5.0) creating dramatic lighting

states.name: Full Rotation
states.description: Exhibit rotated to near-maximum angle (>300 degrees) showing all viewing angles

states.name: Stable Exhibition
states.description: Scene running stably with all interactions functional for extended period

postconditions: All assets (DamagedHelmet and 3 ShaderBall pedestals) are loaded
Floor has reflective material applied
OrbitControls are enabled with damping
Spotlight is active in the scene
Exhibit rotation is set to 120 degrees
Pedestal group has rotated around Y-axis
Rotation value is within valid range

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const spotSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.max === '5' || s.step === '0.1'); if(spotSlider) { spotSlider.value = 2.5; spotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Spotlight intensity adjusted to mid-range value (2.5)
Helmet illumination has changed
Intensity value is within valid range (0.0-5.0)

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const spotSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.max === '5' || s.step === '0.1'); if(spotSlider) { spotSlider.value = 5.0; spotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Spotlight intensity set to maximum (5.0)
Dramatic lighting effect on helmet
Intensity at upper bound of valid range

action.code: const rotSlider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); rotSlider.value = 315; rotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));

postconditions: Exhibit rotated to 315 degrees
Near-complete rotation showing all viewing angles
Rotation value near maximum of range

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); sliders[0].value = 0; sliders[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); const spotSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.max === '5' || s.step === '0.1'); if(spotSlider) { spotSlider.value = 1.5; spotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Exhibit rotation reset to 0 degrees
Spotlight intensity set to moderate level (1.5)
Scene returned to neutral viewing state
Scene remains stable for 60 seconds
All state values remain valid and finite
No crashes or errors during extended runtime
